title: The House with the Quiet Door
synopsis: All six friends enjoy an ordinary Story House afternoon; Amy keeps the old squeak curl on her map and adds a small blue dot for the new latch click.
continuity_state: Before: Six children already know one another. The repaired Story House door opens silently and clicks softly. Ben wibble-waves, Sue has a flup-flap castle bakery door and window-order sign, Kim knows the latch click, Wendy has a ribbon-knock memory, and Todd knows the damp-boot shup. Amy's yellow map still contains the old curl. After: At an ordinary Story House visit, Amy intentionally adds a tiny blue dot beside the old squeak curl on her real yellow map, to represent the door's present soft latch click. Both marks remain; map returns to Amy's home. The six-page Book of Little Sounds is looked at with Ben's permission and returned to its original shelf position beside the Button Town envelope and garden folder. The tilted lantern, garden, Ben's scarf, Kim's three pebbles, Wendy's hat/banner, Todd's boots, Sue's cushion/bakery, and all homes/routes stay as previously recorded. The season ends with the repaired quiet door and no pending event.
